title: Why we do not serve demons (chs. 1–18)
english: Book VIII begins under the only-begotten Word’s help. Celsus asked why we do not cultivate demons; Origen continues that answer from the divine word’s intent.
translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 2–3 Perseus TEI; no Chadwick/ANF Crombie.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B; condensed book CLOSEOUT.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Demons are not “of God” for worship (chs. 19–36)
english: Celsus says demons are God’s and so must be trusted and sacrificed to by law; we refuse that leap — being creatures does not make them objects of cult.
translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 2–3 Perseus TEI; no Chadwick/ANF Crombie.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B; condensed book CLOSEOUT.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Desire of the body and the promises (chs. 37–55)
english: Accused of longing for the body: if desire is base we long for nothing base; if indifferent, we long for what God promises the righteous.
translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 2–3 Perseus TEI; no Chadwick/ANF Crombie.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B; condensed book CLOSEOUT.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Rule the fatherland — SERIES path to CLOSEOUT (chs. 56–75)
english: Celsus urges us to rule the fatherland for the laws’ salvation; we answer that in each city we have another fatherland-system — the church — and serve the common good without idolatrous office. BOOK VIII CLOSEOUT.
translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 2–3 Perseus TEI; no Chadwick/ANF Crombie.
